authenticity_review: Image demonstrates strong photorealism in lighting and composition but exhibits moderate AI artifacts. Fusion occurs at raccoon-toy boundaries (lower-left chin area) and between adjacent raccoons. Bottom-right raccoon paws show structural collapse with indistinct digits. Fur texture displays localized painterly smoothing on top-right head. These defects reduce authenticity but do not dominate the overall quality. Perceptual auditor correctly found no graphics-level distortions (noise/compression/blur).
key_defects: Critical spatial failure: raccoons positioned around/behind toy, not under it
Count error: two toys detected vs. expected one
Fusion artifact at central cluster boundaries (raccoon-toy and inter-raccoon)
Structural collapse in bottom-right raccoon paw anatomy
Minor texture anomaly: painterly fur smoothing on top-right raccoon
